ranked_facts.why: The new onset 2/6 holosystolic murmur is more consistent with infective endocarditis, particularly in the context of a prosthetic mitral valve, than with non-infective endocarditis or other cardiac valve disorders.

The presence of a prosthetic mitral valve with an indolent months-long illness is more suggestive of infective endocarditis, which has a subacute presentation, than of non-infective endocarditis or other conditions.
